description.html: The largest model in our range by volume: about 398 liters in a 75x59x90 cm enclosure, divided into two compartments one above the other. Each level has a 75x59 cm floor, or 4425 cm², sliding glass and a 3D styrofoam background. The ventilation is mesh, at the top and between the levels.

The 59 cm depth is the greatest among our terrariums, so each level can be densely planted and fitted with thick branches. The height of one level is slightly less than 45 cm. That suits a pair of crested geckos, and gives a young green tree python or emerald tree boa horizontal branches 70 cm long. Adult chameleons need a taller, single-compartment space.

An enclosure of this width does not pass through every door, so before ordering, check that your doors and hallway are wider than 60 cm. We can also build it as two separate terrariums that stack. Allow 7 to 14 days for the build. The film on the outer sides is chosen from 34 patterns, the same for both levels.
